Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL4105860. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for target chembl_id CHEMBL4105860. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
